4. Similarly, the CLMUL check in minisketch was made warning-free.

5. The sanitizer and fuzzer checks was made warning-free.

6. We expect that neither the compiler flags nor the test source triggers any warnings, such as `-Wunknown-argument`. Therefore, append `working_compiler_werror_flag`, as done in [`try_append_cxx_flags()`](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/cmake/module/TryAppendCXXFlags.cmake).

7. `-msse4` is merely a synonym for `-msse4.2` in both GCC and Clang, but it is not accepted by the clang-cl frontend. Furthermore, the x86 SHA-NI code uses only SSE4.1 intrinsics and no SSE4.2 ones.

Replace `-msse4` with `-msse4.1` to resolve both issues.

The absence of SSE4.2 usage can be verified by building with `-DAPPEND_CXXFLAGS=-mno-sse4.2`.
